newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France widens collateral terms.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France widens collateral terms.

text.p: The Bank of France said on Thursday it had decided to widen the scope of collateral that can be used to obtain refinancing from the central bank to include lease rental claims.

The move "will contribute to extending the pool of private claims eligible for collateral in monetary policy operations and broaden the Bank's usual range of counterparties," the Bank said in a statement.
The Bank currently accepts Treasury bills and private paper as collateral at its weekly securities repurchase tenders.
It said the new measure was designed to allow credit institutions with leasing actvities, such as equipment and property, access to refinancing from the central bank.
All credit institutions may take advantage of the move, whether or not they specialise in leasing transactions, the Bank said.
The claims involved are estimated to amount to some 30 billion francs, the Bank said.
